As a Technician Assembler, you will be responsible for assembling complex technical systems and modules. You ensure that products are accurately built according to technical drawings and work instructions. Your tasks include: Assembling mechanical and electromechanical modules and systems Working according to technical drawings, schematics, and work instructions Building cabinets, subassemblies, and components Performing quality checks and measurements Identifying deviations and contributing to improvements Collaborating with colleagues from production, engineering, and quality departments You will work in a two-shift schedule: Morning shift: 06:00 – 14:15 Afternoon shift: 14:15 – 23:00 Friday: until approximately 20:30 What skills do you have? An SMD Technician, or Surface Mount Device Technician, plays a crucial role in this type of company, especially when it comes to the production of electronic circuit boards, also known as PCBs (Printed Circuit Boards).

Company description:At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.Job description:  Plan and deliver complex international project schedules Are you an experienced project planner who enjoys working with large-scale projects from tender phase through execution to completion? As a Senior Project Planner at NKT, you will play a key role in planning, monitoring, and reporting across complex projects that support the green transition. Working closely with international teams, clients, and project stakeholders, you will help ensure transparent and reliable project execution. Would you like to contribute to some of the infrastructure projects shaping a more sustainable future?   Coordinate planning across major project phases As Senior Project Planner, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimising integrated project schedules covering the full project lifecycle. You will work closely with project teams, clients, subcontractors, and management to provide clear visibility of project progress and support informed decision-making through accurate planning and reporting.
